scope.summary: This standard prescribes the technical specifications, chemical tolerances, and the methods of sampling and test for fenvalerate, technical, which is a broad-spectrum synthetic pyrethroid insecticide widely used in agricultural, public health, and veterinary pest control.

version_status_and_amendments.amendment_slips: This copy incorporates active Amendment Slips No. 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 (with active updates up to Amendment No. 5, reflecting the continuous technical maintenance of the standard).

certification_and_marking.certification_status: Voluntary/Mandatory under the Insecticides Act. Manufacturers are highly encouraged to apply for the prestigious BIS 'Standard Mark' (ISI Mark) to print on product containers as a certified assurance of quality. Additionally, all packaging, labeling, and distribution of technical-grade fenvalerate must strictly comply with statutory registrations, warning colors, and caution declarations mandated under the Insecticides Act, 1968 and Rules framed thereunder.

requirements.detail: Mandates that the active fenvalerate content shall be a minimum of 92.0 percent by weight (percent w/w minimum), quantitatively determined by Gas Liquid Chromatography (GLC) using Flame Ionization Detection (FID) and an internal standard calibration technique.
Fenvalerate, technical shall be in the form of a viscous, yellow or brown liquid or semi-solid mass with a mild chemical odor, free from extraneous matter and visible impurities.
Restricts materials insoluble in acetone to a maximum of 0.5 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 9 of IS 6940.
Restricts free acidity (calculated as H2SO4) to a maximum of 0.5 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 11.3 of IS 6940.

Requires dissolving about 100 mg of fenvalerate, technical in chloroform (or other compatible organic solvent) together with a specified internal standard—such as 2-(4-biphenyl)-5-phenyl-1,3,4-oxadiazole—before injecting into the gas-chromatographic system.

Requires a high-precision chromatographic column (such as a 3% OV-17 glass column or capillary equivalent) equipped with a Flame Ionization Detector (FID) to resolve active fenvalerate isomers and the internal standard.
Technical-grade material must be securely packed in solid-grade containers satisfying the requirements of IS 8190 (Part 1) or liquid-grade steel drums satisfying IS 8190 (Part 2).

Each container must legibly and indelibly bear: the name of the material, manufacturer's name and address, batch number, date of manufacture, date of expiry, net quantity, nominal fenvalerate content, and standard cautionary notices and toxic warnings worded in accordance with the Insecticides Act, 1968.

For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final observed or calculated value of any test or analysis (such as active content, acidity, or acetone insolubles) must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960. The number of significant places retained should match the specified value.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 12003 : 1987 is the national Indian Standard specification establishing technical requirements, sampling plans, and analytical methods for fenvalerate, technical. Developed under the Pest Control Sectional Committee (AFCDC 6 / FAD 1) and reaffirmed in 2022, this standard regulates the chemical quality of this vital synthetic pyrethroid active ingredient used to formulate commercial insecticides. It mandates a minimum active purity of 92.0% by mass, limits moisture and free acidity to 0.5%, and caps acetone insolubles at 0.5%. It prescribes a high-precision Gas Liquid Chromatography (GLC) method using an internal standard (such as 2-(4-biphenyl)-5-phenyl-1,3,4-oxadiazole) to estimate active content, ensuring standard conformity and safety under the Insecticides Act, 1968.
